I'm not sure of what your tastes are but I put nearly 400 hours into warframe. It's an over the shoulder shooter/melee combat game. PvE. You run missions with other players using suits called frames that all have different abilities and tools/utilities that benefit the mission or your group.

It's free to play and the only thing that real money gets you is quicker access to items and frames that you can get yourself in game by running missions. I had all the frames and weapons I wanted after a week or two of playing. So it's not a horrible grind.

They're about to revamp the parkour in game (your character can parkour everywhere) in the coming weeks.

It has a pretty large player base and the devs are vocal and play within the community as well. Everyone I've met in game has been helpful and nice.

I recommended that if you're into that genre and want to have something to dunno a ton of time into

They've added an actual storyline now that have story missions for you to follow. Ton of new frames, ton of new weapons,a pet you can get that fights alongside you (a wolf looking creature).
